meta.title: mdeverything — read, comment and edit Markdown for AI review
meta.description: Free browser app to read, comment on and edit Markdown, then export a clean, structured context package for AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. Inline comments, outline, Markdown editor, three reading themes.
meta.keywords: markdown editor, markdown annotation, annotate markdown, markdown comments, AI document review, context for ChatGPT, Claude document review, Gemini, markdown reader
meta.ogTitle: mdeverything — Read, comment and edit Markdown for AI review
meta.ogDescription: Highlight any passage in a Markdown document, leave an inline comment, edit the source, then copy a structured bundle (quote, section, context, replies) for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or your coding assistant. No sign-up, runs in your browser.
meta.ogImageAlt: mdeverything — read, comment and edit Markdown for AI review
meta.twitterDescription: Read, comment on and edit Markdown, then export a clean context package for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or your coding assistant. Free and runs entirely in your browser.
meta.ldAlternateName: mdeverything — Markdown reader, commenter and editor for AI review
meta.ldDescription: Free browser app to read, comment on and edit Markdown documents, then export a clean, structured context package for AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.
meta.ldFeature1: Inline comments on any passage, with replies and resolve
meta.ldFeature3: Markdown editor with formatting toolbar and live preview
meta.ldFeature4: Paper, Sepia and Night reading themes
meta.ldFeature5: Export a structured context bundle (quote, section, context, replies) for AI assistants
meta.ldFeature6: Renders Mermaid diagrams and GitHub-flavored Markdown
meta.ldFeature7: Runs entirely client-side with no sign-up or upload

how.title: How it works
how.mockDoc_html: Free for teams of up to 5 people. Billing starts on day one1 for everyone else.
how.mockNote: Is that right? I thought there's a 14-day trial.
how.s1Text: Open or paste any Markdown file. Select a passage and write what should change.
how.mockExport_html: [1] {#n3f9a} Location: section “Pricing” Quoted passage: "Billing starts on day one" Note: Is that right? I thought…
how.s2Text: Export copies the whole document with every comment pinned to its passage. Paste it into ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.
how.mockReply: Yes — paid plans start with a 14-day trial.
how.mockDiff_html: Billing starts <del>on day one</del> <ins>after a 14-day free trial</ins>
how.s3Text_html: Paste the reply back. Each answer lands under its own comment, with suggested edits shown as <del>old</del> → <ins>new</ins>. Accept or reject each one.
how.loopText: Reply or add comments and export again — only new and follow-up comments get answered.
how.foot: Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini — no account, nothing uploaded

why.c1Text: Each comment carries its quote, section and surrounding text, so answers land on the right sentence.
why.c2Text: No upload, no account, no tracking. Your work stays on this device.
why.c3Text: Comments anchor to the exact words — English, Tiếng Việt, 日本語 alike.
